li.label: my family is together
li.description: We sleep under the same roof, whatever else is done to us.

li.label: my family is kept apart
li.description: They sleep in another room, and I cannot reach them.

li.label: was spoken to properly
li.description: Someone sat down with me and listened.

li.label: saw family
li.description: I was allowed to see someone of my own blood.

li.label: visited kin
li.description: I was let in to see my relative, and they are alive.
